Two upgraded clients should be able to use a new encryption method through the same relay.

The relay checks the outer event and its admission rules. The recipient understands the encrypted payload. Our local envelope already has a version byte and a suite byte, so no universal encryption field is needed.

We have added diagrams and examples covering suite rollout, relay policies and what happens when a peer or route is incompatible. The new relay and authentication formats remain proposals.

There is a real bandwidth cost: the audit’s 280-byte chat becomes 5295 bytes as a hybrid gift wrap, versus 2567 classically.
